diagnostic_targets: Deep heavy trunk with strong hindquarters, long stiff tapering tail and elongated low beaked head.
Robust shorter forelimbs support a neutral quadrupedal stance with subhorizontal back; no kangaroo tripod or tail dragging.
Each hand has a conspicuous conical digit-I spike distinct from load-bearing digits II-IV and a separate flexible digit V.
Three central fingers form broad compact hoof-like load-bearing unit; not human palm splay, not five identical clawed toes.
No nasal horn or cranial crest. Maintain complete torso, neck, tail and four limbs; not gracile Mantellisaurus.

scale.basis: NHM10m estimate; Belgian institute adult range9-11m. Not museum mount bounding length.

scientific_limits.en: Living reconstruction, not fossil scan. Ten metres is an NHM taxon estimate within the Belgian institute adult range, not measured length of photographed R51. Original upright mounts and burial drawings do not prescribe living posture. Soft tissues and colours are interpretative; exact gait remains debated.
scientific_limits.zh: 完整成体活体复原，非扫描化石。10米为博物馆物种估值，非照片R51实测全长。旧直立装架和埋藏线描不规定活体姿态；软组织颜色为推断，精确步态仍有争论。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete adult with large thumb spikes, deep body and broad weight-bearing hands. No juvenile, isolated hand or skeletal-display substitution.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: IRSNB R51 holotype described on Belgian institute collection page; associated museum gallery photo and original Lavalette lettre A fossil drawing. Separate museum-published hand photo has no accession asserted.
